rounds.text: Organic Coatings Ltd is demonstrating a powerful and accelerating top-line turnaround, evidenced by compounded sales growth reaching 15% over 5 years [E14], moderating to 7% over 3 years [E15], and surging dramatically to 40% in the trailing twelve months [E16]. This explosive commercial momentum is further underscored by screens highlighting YoY sales increases of 59% [E59] alongside robust underlying demand [E60]. This top-line expansion is successfully beginning to translate into the bottom line, with trailing twelve-month profit growth hitting 14% [E18] and recent profit growth outpacing 1-year price growth by a ratio of 3.50, signaling that the company is starting to outperform market expectations [E49]. Furthermore, the business is benefiting from a supportive macroeconomic environment, operating within a sector boasting a median sales growth of 17.9% [E71] and a sector median profit growth of 34.0% [E70].
